Light of various colors appears like an emanation of all world systems, like an illusion, a rainbow, a mirage, the moon reflected in water, or a reflected image. From that blue lotus <term>utpala</term> <gloss>blue water lily</gloss> arises a blue Tara with two hands. Her right hand holds a trident <term>trishula</term> <gloss>three-pronged spear</gloss>, and her left hand holds a blue lotus with its stalk. Her beautiful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various types of ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth with a smiling face. She sits in the cross-legged posture <term>paryanka</term> <gloss>meditative sitting position</gloss> upon a moon and lotus seat.

In the south, upon a moon and lotus, from the syllable <term>Re</term> arises a yellow blue-lotus together with its seed-syllable. It pervades all world systems. Light of various colors appears like an emanation of all worlds, like an illusion, a rainbow, a mirage, the moon reflected in water, or a reflected image. From that blue lotus arises a Tara with a body the color of refined gold. She has two hands; the right holds a sword, and the left holds a blue lotus with its stalk. Her beautiful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth with a slightly smiling face. Through light of various colors, all world systems appear like an emanation, like an illusion, a rainbow, a mirage, the moon reflected in water, or a reflected image. From that blue lotus arises Tara <term>Ankusha</term> <gloss>The Hook</gloss>. Her body is white, and her two hands hold a hook. Her wrathful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various types of ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth with a slightly wrathful face. She sits in a posture with legs extended and drawn in <term>alidhasana</term> <gloss>a dynamic standing or sitting posture</gloss> upon a moon and lotus.
